name: UI, Workbenches, and Interaction State
purpose: Define the shared interaction grammar, responsive workbench composition, application working-copy/conflict model, command presentation, confirmation tiers and accessibility boundaries without turning UI state into domain authority.

decisions.decision: Keyboard focus, active row/node, single selection, multi-selection membership, expansion and opened record are independent UI states and never silently substitute for one another.
Single click selects; double-click or Enter opens; nested controls perform only their own action. Touch receives an explicit labelled Open action.
Scroll input belongs to the nearest legitimate hovered/focused/gesture-origin scroll surface and does not chain into sibling/underlying panes at a boundary.
Autocomplete/search choosers are bounded, query-identity-aware and never create entities/relationships from typed text or visual similarity; creation is a separate labelled domain command.
Responsive reflow preserves capability, material facts, warnings, commands, working copies, selection and communication context; narrow layout may change composition but not semantics.
Confirmation friction is consequence-based: ordinary activation, deliberate three-second hold, impact preview, preview+hold or owning-domain authority. Hold never replaces required impact review.
Device Reference promotion is an allowlisted exact three-second monotonic deliberate hold with equivalent pointer/touch/keyboard behavior and fresh state revalidation on completion.
Unsaved UI working copy, last accepted revision and persistent domain Draft lifecycle state are distinct. Unsaved state is never authoritative and stale saves never use last-write-wins.
Undo exists only for a currently valid bounded safe inverse; accepted evidence/lifecycle changes use owning-domain correction/supersession/cancellation/replacement/resend rather than generic UI undo.

Ticket workbenches use one focused list/detail/evidence model with domain-owned tabs/actions and canonical communication presentation; workbench views never duplicate message bodies or create alternate relationship authority.
Relationship consolidation/linking uses an explicit reviewed context/impact preview and never silently merges entity identities or copies related-domain truth.
Semantic tokens/skins/appearance may alter presentation only; layout, workflow, command availability, status meaning, confirmation friction and accessibility remain invariant across skins.

unresolved_here_by_design: exact component library and state-management library
exact visual skin token values and rendering tolerances
exact semantic field-bound registry and measured pagination/virtualization limits
